scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @taskgo/web && npm run typecheck -w @taskgo/socket-server && npm run typecheck -w @taskgo/functions
scripts.test:socket: npm run build:socket && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-taskgo "npm run verify:socket -w @taskgo/socket-server"
scripts.test:live-chat: npm run build:socket && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-taskgo "npm run verify:live-chat -w @taskgo/web"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && npm run prepare:emulator && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-taskgo
scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-taskgo "npm run verify:firebase -w @taskgo/web"
scripts.test:auth: npm run build:functions && npm run prepare:emulator && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-taskgo "npm run verify:auth -w @taskgo/web"
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build:functions && npm run prepare:emulator && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-taskgo "npm run verify:workspace -w @taskgo/web"
